public_rationale: The institutional comparison holds. The hearing included government licensing, revocation, FDA-like review before deployment, and independent audits. The official account of the June 5 bill instead describes developer self-certification and a limited-duty exemption. These are substantial differences in gatekeeping and review. This supports the contextual reading, rather than a claim that every obligation in SB-1047 was weaker.
limitations: The result depends on reading strength through the licensing and review mechanisms highlighted in the surrounding passage.
The official June 18 analysis also discusses proposed amendments; only its explicit description of the June 5 bill in print is treated as outcome evidence.
The comparison does not dismiss the bill's safety duties or enforcement powers.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: SB-1047 is in many ways much weaker than the AI regulation Marcus and Sam Altman discussed at the Senate in 2023.

statement.excerpt: In many ways, it is much weaker than what Altman and I talked about at the Senate last year.
statement.document_title: The misguided backlash against California’s SB-1047

from_speaker: what Altman and I talked about at the Senate last year
our_interpretation: Compare the June 5, 2024 version of SB-1047 with the regulatory proposals discussed at the May 16, 2023 Senate hearing.
The surrounding discussion makes government licensing, approval before deployment, and external safety review the relevant dimensions of strength.
The plain reading is that the bill omitted substantial regulatory controls advocated at the hearing, not that every provision was weaker.
The target period encompasses both sides of this explicitly historical comparison.
criteria.support_condition: The hearing record advocates substantial government gatekeeping and external review requirements that the June 2024 bill replaces with materially less demanding arrangements.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The June 2024 bill contains substantially equivalent or stronger requirements on those dimensions, or the hearing record does not contain the attributed proposals.
